scope: Static inspection of 694 root verify_*.py files, exact Git-blob matched to the recorded evidence commit. Four one-line regular expressions identify selected progress and partial-state assertion patterns; they do not establish all equivalent patterns, executable paths or the number of unique affected scripts.
concrete_example: verify_delegated_reconciliation_4_95e.py asserts that the live q1859 current_reconciliation starts with partial and that live lenses_complete and queue_records_semantically_reconciled equal zero. Those facts describe the observed checkpoint, but treating them as permanent live-state invariants would reject a later justified closure.
candidate_count_qualification: The candidate-count pattern compares a live count to the live ledger length and is not by itself evidence of a frozen zero-state constraint.
consequence: Before recording any actual completed lens or semantically reconciled queue row that conflicts with a historical check, establish a reviewed evidence-verification method that preserves the earlier assertion against its exact time-bound state while separately validating the new live state. Do not remove or silently weaken historical assertions. No such adaptation is implemented or independently approved here.
limits: No audit lens or queue row is closed by this inspection; no original historical record is overwritten. The reported checkpoint was published and its same-machine recovery check was still ongoing when this inventory was made.
